compiled_state.title: recover-reaped-worktree.sh: Tier-2 git add exit status unchecked -> false RECOVERED_FROM_SESSION on add failure
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick (opus FP-recovery review of PR #548; severity minor)

#### Expected Behavior
recover-reaped-worktree.sh Tier 2 should only emit RECOVERED_FROM_SESSION + exit 0 when 'git add' actually succeeds.

#### Actual Behavior
Line ~106 runs 'git add -- "${RECOVERED_ARR[@]}"' under 'set -uo pipefail' (no -e) without checking the result; a failed git add still falls through to echo RECOVERED_FROM_SESSION + exit 0, mis-marking recovery as successful. Non-blocking in practice: best-effort helper invoked only after a reaped worktree; the caller (single-agent-integrate.md / per-worktree-review-commit.md) treats the token as advisory and re-stages via the normal commit path, so no work loss. Fix: check git add exit and emit UNRECOVERABLE_REDISPATCH (exit 3) on failure. Confirmed minor by opus reviewer (hash 47c56f38...) during PR #548 FP-recovery.
